name: May I Take Your Order?
source:
Tonight, we're pleased to serve you a fun little romantic dish with a scoop of horror and a nice, bloody ganache. May I Take Your Order is a short visual novel about a half hour long with five endings. You play as a waiter serving a couple with...strange tastes.

[From [url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/may-i-take-your-order]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今晚，我们很高兴为你提供一道有趣的浪漫小菜，其中有一勺恐怖和美味的血腥甘纳许。我可以接受你的订单是一部大约半小时长的短篇视觉小说，有五个结局。你扮演一名服务员，为一对口味奇怪的夫妇服务。

[来自[url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/may-i-take-your-order]Itch.io[/url]]
